title: Add FSChart to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [FSChart](https://fastnow.github.io/fschart_pollinations) to build
- FSChart converts natural language into 3D models and 2D function plots in the browser. Enter “a rotating red cube” or “plot y=sin(x)” to call Pollinations and render.

Fixes #13311

gist.headline: Words become wireframes
gist.blurb: FSChart joined the garden: type a thought like “a rotating red cube” or “plot y=sin(x),” and watch it grow into something you can inspect. Apparently plain language has geometry now.
gist.summary: Added FSChart to the app build, giving users a browser-based tool that calls Pollinations to turn natural-language prompts into 3D models and 2D function plots.
gist.impact: Users can now open FSChart and create scenes such as a rotating red cube or graphs such as y=sin(x) directly from a plain-language prompt.
gist.visual_concept: Depict FSChart as a cozy browser-workshop where language becomes visible geometry: a glowing retro monitor shows a chunky rotating red cube beside a friendly sine-wave graph. Polli, wearing tiny round mathematician glasses, hovers beside the keyboard and points at a prompt card, while code-plants and small flowers grow around the desk to connect the app to the Pollinations garden.
